# solidping_status_page_section (Resource)

A section of a status page, with the components it shows.

A section is either hand-curated (`resources`, an ordered list of checks and check groups) or dynamic (`selector`, a rule the server evaluates to pick the checks).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A hand-curated section: the components are listed in display order.
resource "solidping_status_page_section" "core" {
  status_page_uid = solidping_status_page.public.id
  name            = "Core services"

  resources = [
    {
      check_uid   = solidping_check.website.id
      public_name = "Website"
    },
    {
      check_uid   = solidping_check.database.id
      public_name = "Database"
      explanation = "Primary PostgreSQL cluster"
    },
  ]
}

# A dynamic section: every check labelled team=web, kept up to date by SolidPing.
resource "solidping_status_page_section" "web" {
  status_page_uid = solidping_status_page.public.id
  name            = "Web"

  selector = {
    labels = { team = "web" }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Title of the section.
- `status_page_uid` (String) UID of the status page. Changing it replaces the section.

### Optional

- `position` (Number) Position of the section in the page (0 is the top). Appended after the existing sections when omitted.
- `resources` (Attributes List) Components shown in the section, in display order. Each one targets a check (`check_uid`) or a check group (`check_group_uid`), shown as one aggregated component. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `selector` (Attributes) Dynamic membership rule. Exactly one of `all`, `labels` and `check_group_uid` must be set. Conflicts with `resources`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--selector))
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly identifier, unique in the page. Derived from `name` when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UID of the section.

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Optional:

- `check_group_uid` (String) UID of the check group to show.
- `check_uid` (String) UID of the check to show.
- `explanation` (String) Short text shown with the component.
- `public_name` (String) Name shown on the page instead of the check or group name.


<a id="nestedatt--selector"></a>
### Nested Schema for `selector`

Optional:

- `all` (Boolean) Select every check of the organization.
- `check_group_uid` (String) Select every check of this check group (UID).
- `labels` (Map of String) Select the checks carrying all of these labels.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A section is imported with `org/statusPageUid/sectionUid`.
terraform import solidping_status_page_section.core acme/0190f3a2-7c1d-7e3b-9a55-2f4f8a1b6c7d/0190f3a2-8d2e-7f4c-8b66-3a5a9b2c7d8e
```
